cta.title: Connect an AI model to generate your interpretation
cta.body: Your chart is calculated on-device. To turn it into a personalized reading, connect an AI model — use the one-click OpenRouter preset or point AlmaMesh at a local model (e.g. Ollama).

generation.elapsed: Generating from your model — {{elapsed}} elapsed. A full reading can take 1–3 minutes on a cloud model.
generation.model_unavailable: The AI model in your settings isn't available on your endpoint — so the reading couldn't be generated. Switch to the recommended model and try again.
generation.partial_failure: Some sections could not be generated this time: {{sections}}. The rest of the reading is complete — regenerate to fill the gap.
generation.regen_failed: The reading could not be regenerated ({{error}}). Your previous reading is kept below.

reading.regen_no_ai: Connect an AI model to regenerate this reading.

grounding.intro: No hype — just how it works. Here's why you can trust what you're reading:
grounding.point_engine: Your birth chart is deterministic astronomy, computed on your device: the same birth details always produce the exact same chart.
grounding.point_validated: The planetary positions come from Skyfield and NASA's JPL DE421 ephemeris, checked to sub-arcsecond accuracy against astropy and JPL Horizons — no Swiss Ephemeris, no fudge factors.
grounding.point_grounded: The AI narration is grounded in your chart: it reads back your exact engine-computed placements — your lagna, planets, dashā and yogas — so it's genuinely yours, not a generic pre-written horoscope.
grounding.point_privacy: Your chart stays private. Nothing about it leaves your device; only a redacted chart — no name, no birth date — is ever sent to the optional AI.

chat.not_configured_notice: Connect an AI model to ask questions about your chart — open Settings → AI Model (or the AI badge in the header) and use the one-click OpenRouter preset, or point AlmaMesh at a local model (e.g. Ollama at http://localhost:11434/v1).
